title: Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology
abstract: arXiv:2610.00529v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The ontology-based contextual AI evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology was developed to address a lack of scientific rigor that arises from unclear testing coverage, to balance human expertise and automations, and to address a lack of reproducibility of AI evaluation testing environments. OB-CAIE strengthens the current state of AI evaluations by addressing the first step in the scientific method by clearly defining what will be tested. Two ontologies represent the tractable problem space in the OB-CAIE methodology: the Domain-Specific Ontology (DSO) and the Evaluation Process Ontology (EPO). The DSO is the what; the EPO is the how. An OB-CAIE problem space can be used for one or multiple AI evaluations. The OB-CAIE methodology allows for human judgment at specific points, in scientifically grounded ways, and in complex subject areas where human feedback is genuinely irreducible or machine irreplaceable. translated_title: 基于本体的情境化人工智能评估（OB-CAIE）方法论
translated_abstract: 基于本体的情境化人工智能评估（OB-CAIE）方法论旨在解决因测试覆盖范围不明确而导致的科学严谨性缺失问题，平衡人类专业知识与自动化，并解决人工智能评估测试环境缺乏可重复性的问题。OB-CAIE通过明确界定将要测试的内容——即落实科学方法的第一步——来强化当前人工智能评估的现状。两个本体共同表示OB-CAIE方法论中可处理的问题空间：领域专用本体（DSO）和评估过程本体（EPO）。DSO回答“测什么”，EPO回答“怎么测”。一个OB-CAIE问题空间可用于一次或多次人工智能评估。OB-CAIE方法论允许在特定环节以科学依据充分的方式引入人类判断，尤其适用于人类反馈真正不可简化或机器无法替代的复杂学科领域。
tldr: 提出了一种基于双本体（领域专用本体DSO与评估过程本体EPO）的情境化AI评估方法论OB-CAIE，通过明确界定测试内容、科学地平衡人类判断与自动化、提升测试环境可重复性，来增强AI评估的科学严谨性。
en_tdlr: Proposes OB-CAIE, an ontology-based contextual AI evaluation methodology using two ontologies (Domain-Specific Ontology and Evaluation Process Ontology) to clearly define test coverage, scientifically balance human judgment with automation, and improve the reproducibility of AI evaluation environments.
